algorithm: Validate full selected/result IDs/order/metadata first as before.

For each row, validate its own source-derived row kind including prerequisite metadata if present. If earlier real stopAfterExact requires a stopped suffix, require current plain stopped shape. Known authored-plan missing-executor not-implemented is allowed only with its exact source-derived action marker and retained prefix; arbitrary present-plan not-implemented is not accepted.
Ordinary initial prerequisite not-run and recheck without stop category are local partial rows; do not flip a global stopped bit merely on category:not-run.
A plain not-run without prerequisiteFailure denotes the allowed stopped suffix shape; all its subsequent rows must be plain stopped, no fabricated cause.
After a reached row, use exact stopAfterExact to constrain following suffix; retain its own partial exchanges/actions and raw report digest.

Separate nested inventory validation from authored-outcome reduction. Unexecuted/prerequisite-not-run remains null even with retained recheck evidence; do not call every([]) or join prerequisite assertions as a dependent pass.
